how_mcp_published.prose: Directory honesty badge is official. That badge is copied from 01-clay (mcp_status official, last_checked 2026-09-03). Clay publishes a first-party hosted MCP page at https://www.clay.com/mcp and workspace-admin docs at https://university.clay.com/docs/mcp-settings. The first-party GitHub org clay-run publishes agent-plugins, which mentions MCP tools and the Clay CLI. The community repo shanefirek/clay-mcp-public is third-party and is not an official Clay server. This sidecar does not invent a tool count and does not copy the community tool list onto the official badge.
